balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for approximately 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It blends broad index exposure with quality tech and a small amount of leverage, offering a moderate risk/reward profile. Expect controlled drawdowns with growth potential.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It leans into leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups, which significantly amplifies both upside and potential drawdowns. Be aware that leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this mode can lead to substantial losses quickly if stops are not strictly adhered to.

income.read: This income plan targets approximately 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It rotates heavily into income ETFs and broad index, cutting leverage and high-beta names to near zero. While prioritizing low drawdown and reliable distributions, remember that distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
